		USA = {
			diplomatic_relation = { country = KOR relation = military_access active = no }

	}
}
COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_conduct = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_can_conduct = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					USA = { has_military_access_to = KOR }
				}
			}
			give_military_access = USA
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_temporary_access
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				KOR = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_kind = 1 }
				}
			}
			KOR = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2 }

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running }
				USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running }
			}
		}
		KOR = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_training_open

		USA = {
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_training_open
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise.9 }
		}
	}
	KOR = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_burden
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_kor_reward
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_usa_reward
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_burden
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_kor_reward
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_usa_reward
	}
	USA = {
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_burden
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_kor_reward
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_usa_reward
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_burden
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_kor_reward

COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_daily = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_pair_active = yes }
				AND = {
					OR = {
						KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running }
						USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running }
					}
					NOT = { COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_training_feasible = yes }
				}
			}
			OR = {
				OR = {
					KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running }
					USA = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_running }
				}
				OR = {
					KOR = {
						OR = {
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_kor_reward
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_usa_reward
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_kor_reward
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_usa_reward
						}
					}
					USA = {
						OR = {
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_kor_reward
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_field_usa_reward
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_kor_reward
							has_idea = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_staff_usa_reward
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_abort = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			KOR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_pending }
			NOT = { COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_offer_current = yes }
		}
		COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_clear_offer = yes
		KOR = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_cooldown days = 30 }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise.10 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_complete = yes
}

	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_KOR_usfk_exercise_training_live = yes

		add_to_variable = { additional_expenses_rate = 0.002 }
	}
}
